reviews.summary: Current Cardano mainnet activity appears unusually congested: a HOSKY campaign has driven transaction volume sharply higher, with sampled blocks near capacity and fees elevated. This can raise ADA deposit/withdrawal and confirmation risk around exchange trading.
materialRisks: Mainnet congestion is reported as ongoing on October 10: 1.08M transactions in the first three days of epoch 660, sampled blocks near 97% capacity, and epoch fees already 4.15× the prior full epoch.
Cardano operators are still being urged to run node 11.1.3 after an IPv4-decoding bug in 11.1.2; this is a maintenance/operational risk rather than evidence of a current mainnet outage.

facts.fact: A HOSKY campaign beginning October 7 reportedly caused a large burst of 2-ADA transactions, filling sampled blocks to about 97% of size capacity by October 10.
No current Cardano mainnet outage or consensus exploit was identified in the fresh sources reviewed; reported recent delays were on Preview/PreProd testnets.
Intersect stated on October 9 that node 11.1.3 remains the recommended release, correcting a minor IPv4-address decoding bug in 11.1.2.
Recent official Cardano announcements on October 7–8 concerned CIP-0113 programmable tokens and the .ada ICANN application; neither was identified as an adverse ADA supply or security event.
